newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan interbank rate rises on bond payment.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan interbank rate rises on bond payment.

text.p: Taiwan's interbank rate rose slightly at mid-session on Tuesday as market liquidity tightened on deadline day for payment of T$35 billion in government bonds, dealers said.

The overnight interbank rate was at 5.070 percent against Monday's 4.996 close, with 30-day commercial paper staying flat at 5.00-5.05 percent. Dealers did not expect the rates to rise sharply due to payroll funds re-entering the banking system and upcoming maturation of negotiable certificates of deposit.
In the bond market, the seven-year 86/3 bond yield was at 5.7450-5.7475 against 5.7375. -- Rachel Lee (5080815)
